thread:
Elaine: Heads-up — noticed a bad curl example in the quickstart README. The example posts the token in the query string and has a doubled slash in the URL. :facepalm:

Kevin: ugh, thanks for catching. which file/path?

Elaine: docs/quickstart/README.md — root curl snippet. Copy/paste from that is what a new user would try. Current snippet:```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.run//v1/generate?api_key=sk-XXXX -d '{\n  \"input\": \"hi\"\n}'```

DocBot: automated-doc-scan: quickstart README mismatch vs SDK samples (severity: medium). Suggested fix: replace query param auth with Authorization header and fix URL.

Samir: we should also mention retry behavior — the curl example doesn't set Expect header nor show a retry posture. New users hit 429 and then paste their key into support tickets.

Maria: this one is dangerous because it trains folks to share keys in URLs. Suggest a short footnote: "Never include tokens in URLs; use Authorization header or environment variables."

Kevin: agreed. I'll make a tiny PR to swap to header and add the footnote. Proposed replacement:```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.run/v1/generate" \ \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY' \ \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \ \n  -d '{"input":"hi"}'
```

Elaine: looks good. can we also add a brief note about idempotency/retries for generation endpoint? maybe a single-line: "Transient 429/5xx may be retried with exponential backoff; avoid re-sending unique user actions without dedup keys."

Samir: add a small code comment showing minimal backoff snippet? e.g., `retry with backoff up to 3 attempts` — keep it tiny, not full lib code.

Kevin: will add one-liner and link to retry best-practices doc. PR description will reference issue #4321 and include a sample of the curl change + footnote.

Maria: also add an explicit envvar example for mac/linux and Windows Powershell so people don't paste tokens into the command:```bash
export REDWOOD_API_KEY=sk-...
# then use $REDWOOD_API_KEY in example
```

Elaine: thanks y'all. small fix but high impact for onboarding. :thumbsup:

DocBot: PR opened by Kevin: github.com/redwood/inference/docs/pull/2045 — includes curl fix, footnote, and retry link. (automated)
